case: domain-selected cleanup on a record domain
justification: L3 accepts `dropped by` on a domain and preparation keeps it; Psi has no place for the selected cleanup of a qualified owned occurrence, so L5 refuses the declaration.

case: record domain qualification on a formal
message: no Psi lowering for carrier root\R in root\R::Live
justification: The record domain declaration lowers; a formal of type `R in Live` has no Psi type shape, so L5 refuses the formal.

case: runtime callable with a mutable loan formal
message: no Psi lowering for carrier runtime callable machine(@mut u8) -> u8
justification: The spec publishes `machine(counter: @mut Counter)` callables; L5 has no runtime callable carrier with an exclusive loan formal.

case: runtime callable with a shared record reference formal
message: no Psi lowering for carrier runtime callable machine(@root\Counter) -> u64
justification: The published `CounterValue = machine(counter: @Counter) -> u64` shape refuses; only a shared reference to a scalar has a runtime callable form.

case: runtime callable with a borrowed result
message: no Psi lowering for carrier runtime callable machine(@u8) -> @u8
justification: The callable type owns its result lifetime; L5 has no runtime callable carrier whose result is a reference.

message: normal exit needs an authorized disposition for owned storage
justification: An owned sum whose alternatives own different cleanup dies on the normal exit; L5 has no case-dependent whole-value disposal, while the cleanup-free control lowers.

case: borrow of a qualified scalar formal
message: local binding requires a supported copyable carrier
justification: Borrowing the plain formal gets a primitive home; the qualified formal `u8 in Small` gets none and the binding refuses.

case: float domain qualification on a formal
message: no Psi lowering for carrier f32 in root\f32::Unit
justification: A predicate-free domain on `f32` declares; a formal of type `f32 in Unit` has no Psi carrier, so the float candidate's predicate work cannot reach it.

message: no Psi lowering for carrier runtime callable machine() -> u8
justification: The same callable contract without `suspends` lowers; a contract with a suspension effect has no runtime callable carrier.

case: applied record as a machine formal
message: no Psi lowering for carrier root\Buffer<u32>
justification: Both programs declare the same record family. Changing only the formal from u32 to Buffer<u32> prevents L5 from publishing the selected applied carrier, even when the machine never reads it.

case: declared parent in a trait interface
message: trait binders, inheritance and restrictions require an applied trait interface
justification: Both traits have no members. Adding only the named parent to C prevents L5 from publishing the interface. A separate inherited member selection also prepares and stops at the child trait.

case: shared nominal view as an element count
justification: The view has a typed nominal element and shared access. L5 needs a descriptor retaining both before it can emit the stored element count.
